# FIT test fixtures

Synthetic, deterministic FIT files generated by `make_fixtures.py` (`uv run python tests/fixtures/make_fixtures.py`, from `backend/`). No real personal data: coordinates are made up, near a lake at ~49.0N 8.4E (CEST, UTC+2); serial numbers are made up. Every value below is asserted by `make_fixtures.py`'s own self-check (it re-reads each file with `fitdecode` after writing it) — this table is generated from the same constants, so it cannot drift from the files. Regenerate both together after any change.

`distance` on `record` messages is a per-session odometer that resets to 0 at the start of each session (not a single file-wide cumulative value).

## `apple_multisport.fit`

Reproduces: 5 sessions; dropped trailing bike lap (Trap 1); run power, no bike power (Trap 2); single swim lap (Trap 7); Apple-style developer fields (Trap 10); swim with no altitude (Trap 9).

- `file_id.manufacturer` = `development`, `serial_number` = 100001
- `file_id.time_created` = 2026-07-11T09:00:00Z
- Developer fields (`developer_data_index` 0): `RPE ESTIMATED` (uint8, present on every session, values in session order [4, 3, 7, 3, 6]) and `AVG METs` (float32, declared via `field_description` but never given a value on any message).

| Session | sport/sub_sport | start_time (UTC) | elapsed (s) | timer (s) | distance (m) | ascent (m) | avg/max HR | avg_power (W) | NP (W) | lap distances (m) | laps | records |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| swim | swimming/open_water | 2026-07-11T09:00:00Z | 1800 | 1800 | 1500 | — | 135/150 | — | — | 1500 | 1 | 180 |
| t1 | transition/— | 2026-07-11T09:30:00Z | 180 | 180 | 300 | — | 109/119 | — | — | 300 | 1 | 18 |
| bike | cycling/— | 2026-07-11T09:33:00Z | 4388 | 4388 | 33746 | 558 | 146/168 | — | — | 5000, 5000, 5000, 5000, 5000, 5000 | 6 | 439 |
| t2 | transition/— | 2026-07-11T10:46:08Z | 120 | 120 | 218 | — | 114/123 | — | — | 218 | 1 | 12 |
| run | running/— | 2026-07-11T10:48:08Z | 3363 | 3363 | 9172 | 166 | 151/172 | 300 | — | 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 172 | 10 | 337 |

- Bike laps: 6 lap messages of 5000 m each (30000 m); the session `total_distance` is 33746 m, so the laps undercount the session by 3746 m — the dropped trailing partial lap (Trap 1). Do not derive segment totals from lap sums.
- Run laps: 10 lap messages (9 × 1000 m + a 172 m trailing partial), summing to the full 9172 m session distance — Apple keeps the trailing lap on the run.
- Swim: 1 lap for the whole 1500 m swim (Trap 7).
- `total_elapsed_time == total_timer_time` on every session and lap (no pauses).
- No `avg_power`/`max_power` field on the bike session, its laps, or its records (Trap 2). The run session, its laps, and its records all carry `power`.
- Swim records carry neither `altitude` nor `enhanced_altitude`. Every other session's records carry `enhanced_altitude`.

## `garmin_multisport.fit`

Reproduces: bike power + normalized power (Trap 2); 4 swim laps (Trap 7); smart recording (variable sampling); elapsed ≠ timer (Trap 5); device temperature on every record (Trap 8); one orphan record (Trap 4).

- `file_id.manufacturer` = `garmin`, product `fenix7`, serial 500500500; `file_id.time_created` = 2026-08-15T07:00:00Z
- `device_info`: two messages for the watch itself (`device_index` 0, manufacturer `garmin`, `garmin_product` `fenix7`, serial 500500500), at 2026-08-15T07:00:00Z and 2026-08-15T07:46:40Z.

| Session | sport/sub_sport | start_time (UTC) | elapsed (s) | timer (s) | distance (m) | ascent (m) | avg/max HR | avg_power (W) | NP (W) | lap distances (m) | laps | records |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| swim | swimming/open_water | 2026-08-15T07:00:00Z | 1500 | 1500 | 2000 | — | 131/145 | — | — | 500, 500, 500, 500 | 4 | 150 |
| t1 | transition/— | 2026-08-15T07:25:00Z | 90 | 90 | 150 | — | 107/113 | — | — | 150 | 1 | 9 |
| bike | cycling/— | 2026-08-15T07:26:30Z | 1205.900 | 1200 | 20000 | 210 | 146/165 | 225 | 250 | 5000, 5000, 5000, 5000 | 4 | 603 |
| t2 | transition/— | 2026-08-15T07:46:37Z | 70 | 70 | 90 | — | 113/118 | — | — | 90 | 1 | 7 |
| run | running/— | 2026-08-15T07:47:47Z | 2803 | 2803 | 9239 | 59 | 151/170 | — | — | 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 239 | 10 | 701 |

- Swim: exactly 4 laps of 500 m each (2000 m total) — Trap 7, contrasting with Apple's single swim lap.
- Bike: `total_elapsed_time` = 1205.9 s, `total_timer_time` = 1200.0 s — they differ (Trap 5). `avg_power` = 225 W, `normalized_power` = 250 W (session-level, authored; lap avg_power = 210/220/230/240 W, lap normalized_power = 225/235/245/255 W). Bike records sample every 2 s ("smart recording" proxy).
- Run: no `power` field anywhere (Trap 2). Records sample on a repeating 3 s/5 s/3 s/5 s pattern (~4 s average) instead of a fixed interval.
- Every record in the file (all 5 sessions plus the orphan) carries a `temperature` field, and every session with records after T1 also carries `avg_temperature` (Trap 8).
- Orphan record (Trap 4): the bike session's derived end is start_time + total_elapsed_time = 2026-08-15T07:26:30Z + 1205.9s = 2026-08-15T07:46:35.900Z. T2 starts at 2026-08-15T07:46:37Z, 1.1 s later. One record sits at 2026-08-15T07:46:36Z, inside that gap, matching no session window. It must be counted as an orphan, not silently dropped or assigned.

## `overlap_boundary.fit`

Reproduces: sub-second session overlap (Trap 3). Intentionally tiny.

- `file_id.manufacturer` = `garmin`; `file_id.time_created` = 2026-05-01T06:00:00Z
- Every session's `total_elapsed_time` (and `total_timer_time`) is its whole-second duration plus 0.054 s. Its *derived* end (`start_time + total_elapsed_time`) therefore lands 0.054 s past the next session's recorded `start_time` — the sub-second overlap.
- Records are placed on a 5 s grid (0, 5, 10, … 90) from the file start, which lands exactly on every session boundary (20, 30, 60, 70). Correct half-open `[start, end)` bucketing with each session's end clamped to `min(derived_end, next_session.start_time)` assigns each boundary record to exactly the *next* session, and every record matches exactly one session — no orphans, no double counts. Inclusive or unclamped bucketing double-counts every boundary record (matched by both the ending and the starting session).

| Session | sport/sub_sport | start_time (UTC) | elapsed (s) | timer (s) | distance (m) | ascent (m) | avg/max HR | avg_power (W) | NP (W) | lap distances (m) | laps | records |

| swim | swimming/open_water | 2026-05-01T06:00:00Z | 20.054 | 20.054 | 50 | — | 122/125 | — | — | 50 | 1 | 5 |
| t1 | transition/— | 2026-05-01T06:00:20Z | 10.054 | 10.054 | 15 | — | 101/102 | — | — | 15 | 1 | 3 |

## `edge_single_bike.fit`

Reproduces: a single-sport upload (no multisport session split); `device_info` for a head unit plus three paired sensors with made-up serials; `timestamp_correlation` giving local = UTC+2 (Trap 11 — the correlation-based path, contrasted with `early_start_local_date.fit`'s GPS-based path).

- `file_id.manufacturer` = `garmin`, product `edge_540`, serial 700700700
- `file_id.time_created` = 2026-04-10T08:00:00Z
- `device_info` messages (all at file start time):
  - head unit: `device_index` 0, manufacturer `garmin`, `garmin_product` `edge_540`, serial 700700700
  - power meter pedals: `device_index` 1, manufacturer `favero_electronics`, `favero_product` `assioma_duo`, serial 800800800
  - groupset: `device_index` 2, manufacturer `shimano`, `product` 12917, serial 900900900
  - HR strap: `device_index` 3, manufacturer `polar_electro`, `product` 0, serial 111222333
- `timestamp_correlation`: `system_timestamp` = 2026-04-10T08:00:00Z, `local_timestamp` decodes (via `fitdecode`) to 2026-04-10T10:00:00Z (UTC+2h).

| Session | sport/sub_sport | start_time (UTC) | elapsed (s) | timer (s) | distance (m) | ascent (m) | avg/max HR | avg_power (W) | NP (W) | lap distances (m) | laps | records |

## `early_start_local_date.fit`

Reproduces: UTC date ≠ local date at the race start (Trap 11 — the GPS-based path: no `timestamp_correlation` message is present, so the local date can only come from the start position's timezone).

- `file_id.manufacturer` = `garmin`; `file_id.time_created` = 2026-06-20T22:30:00Z
- First session (`swim`) `start_time` = 2026-06-20T22:30:00Z UTC, at position (49.0, 8.4), which is in the CEST timezone (UTC+2 in June). UTC calendar date = `2026-06-20`; local calendar date = `2026-06-21`.
- No `timestamp_correlation` message is present in this file.

## Regenerating

```
cd backend
uv run python tests/fixtures/make_fixtures.py
```

The script writes the five `.fit` files above and this README from the same constants, then re-reads every file with `fitdecode` and asserts it against those constants. Only changing a fixture needs `fit-tool`/`fitdecode` (dev-only dependencies, never installed in the runtime image); the committed `.fit` files and this README are enough to run the test suite.
